To understand the past, we need to explore historical documents and sources. Learn about the history of writing and books, then make a Japanese-style bound book (watozy-hon) yourself.

Children's Cultural Heritage Class: Make a Japanese-Style Bound Book

Date and time:
December 6 (Sunday, Reiwa 8), 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. (Doors open 9:45 a.m.)

Location:
Hanno City Museum, Study and Research Room

Who can attend:
Elementary school children and younger, with a parent or guardian. (Sharp tools like awls and needles will be used in the craft—parents' help is needed.)

Capacity:
10 groups

How to apply:
From 11:17 a.m. on Tuesday, November 17 (Reiwa 8) to 4:00 p.m. on Tuesday, December 1 (Reiwa 8), apply at the museum. Electronic application is preferred (applications by counter, phone, or email also accepted).

On museum closed days, you may also apply by phone: 042-972-2301, Cultural Heritage Division.

Electronic application form available at the link above.
